evidence_classes.algebraic_qa: Saved-tensor reconstruction or identity; subject to numerical precision; not independent memorization evidence.
evidence_classes.finite_noise_observation: Finite actual learned-branch or endpoint observation; does not establish a population or asymptotic claim.
evidence_classes.candidate_distribution_diagnostic: Exact calculation for an explicitly declared finite candidate distribution, not the learned model posterior or full training law.
evidence_classes.unavailable: Needs missing population information, unrecorded states or new model evaluations.
evidence_classes.model_center_diagnostic: Dispersion relative to a declared estimated model-output center, not agreement with the training mean.
evidence_classes.identified_training_reference: Only for an independently identified actual training law.
evidence_classes.not_applicable: The declared mathematical conditions do not apply; distinct from unavailable inputs or computational failure.

conventions.algebra_guidance_domain: finite real g where a particular algebra formula uses absolute coefficients; distinct from supported generation settings
conventions.latent_units: scaled VAE latent; paper uses raw L2, RMSE=L2/sqrt(d)
conventions.indexing: cache k=0..T-1 labels denoiser inputs, state k+1 is update output; cache k is not the manuscript forward-noise index t; no branch exists at latents[:,T]
conventions.reference_error_warning: Unconditional target error is not unconditional Bayes-reference error. Candidate reference errors use explicit K qualification.
conventions.center_warning: mu_ref is a fixed reference-initial learned unconditional center, held out from experiment seeds but built from the reference seed bank also used for selection
conventions.support_warning: Declared finite candidate distribution D_candidate is not identified with manuscript full training distribution D
conventions.loss_warning: effective_target_noise_residual_mse is exact cache algebra and is not L_t(c)
conventions.proof_kl_direction: D.1 equation (31) uses KL(forward || N(0,I)); optional initialized-to-forward KL is a separate analytic diagnostic, with reverse KL direction
conventions.rendering: Four default designs; optional injection and applicable terminal_terms; matched displacement is numerical QA without a figure. Every emitted figure has PNG/PDF plus caption/provenance sidecars.
